title: On the Extension Theorem for Packing Steiner Forests
summary: We consider the problem of packing edge-disjoint Steiner forests in a graph. The input consists of a multi-graph $G=(V,E)$ and a collection of $t$ vertex subsets $S = \{S_1,S_2,\ldots,S_t\}$. A Steiner forest for $S$, also called an $S$-forest, is a forest of $G$ in which each $S_i$ is connected. In the case where $t=1$, this is the Steiner Tree packing problem. Kriesell's conjecture postulates that $2k$-edge-connectivity of $S_1$ is sufficient to find $k$ edge-disjoint $S_1$-trees.
